profile.headline: Chief Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a well rounded computer scientist with the following direct experience:

Cryptography
Embedded Controllers
RealTime Operating Systems
Radar Technologies
Computational Biology
HPC System Engineering
Large HPC Cluster (compute nodes > 1200, CPU/node > 80)
MPIv1 and MPIv2
Test Engineer (Software Development and Test Harness)
Pre and Post Sales
Large (>$500M) Federal/State Government RFPs

Specialties: Software Development, Testing, Government Proposials, MPI, HPC, Cryptography, Embedded Controllers, RealTime Operating Systems

positions.title: Chief Engineer
positions.insights: Product Design, Software as a Service (SaaS) and +6 skills

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Cyber Test Engineer with experience in leading large teams to deliver value using Agile methodologies.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed test harness for embedded system product; Implemented existing verification test harness in new environment; Lead team of 15 engineers to successful results on time and on budget; Converted test harness from UNIX shell scripts to PERL code and TETware. Implemented hundreds of MATLAB scripts to better automate MATLAB test harness. In charge of all scheduling, reporting to management, and reporting of budget line items. Software verification is final process step in quality software release. Final software release will lead to successful billion dollar contract realization.

Lead Embedded Software Developer for new device.  Application written in C utilized vendors libraries and needed plug into existing architecture.  Developed unit tests to ensure new architecture met the requirements and functionality.

positions.title: Engineering Test Developer
positions.description: Worked to develop a Perl Test harness to create smoke tests, regression tests, and build tests needed to ensure working builds and software releases.

positions.title: System Engineer Sales Support
positions.description: Pre and Post sales support for the Federal government customers.  Achieved quarterly goals for 6 straight quarters.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description: Federal/State/Local government support.  Worked on large RFPs for several government agencies.

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked to coordinate incoming orders electronically and placed order to ensure accurate delivery of cookies.  Coordinated several inperson selling events.  Enabled troop to enter orders electronically using basic google form.
